The '''Sluuce Canyon''' was a canyon located near the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The Sluuce Canyon was a commonly-used route that led to the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] valley.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

==Continuity==
The map included in the [[StarWars.com]] article ''The World of Star Wars: Kenobi'' misspells this location as "Slauce Canyon".<ref name="TWoSWK">{{SW|url=news/the-world-of-star-wars-kenobi|text=The World of ''Star Wars: Kenobi''|nolive=1}}</ref>
